project_title: The Fishing Lands - Fantasy MMO UI Guidelines
theme: Dark Fantasy / League of Angels MMO (Gold, Leather, Mahogany, Gems)

typography.font_rules: Tight tracking on headers (tracking-tight), uppercase overlines with 0.1em spacing. NEVER use Inter/Roboto for headers.

colors.accents: Gold (#f2c14e), Ember (#d99a1f), Cyan Glow (#2ee6ff), Magenta Gem (#e040fb)

global_reskin_recipes..tfl-skin .panel: Replaced with .fr-panel rounded-lg border-2 border-[#c8961f] bg-[linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(38,24,14,0.96),rgba(14,9,6,0.98))] shadow-[0_0_18px_rgba(234,179,8,0.22)]
global_reskin_recipes..tfl-skin .panel-head: Font-Cinzel font-bold text-[#f2c14e] tracking-wider uppercase border-b border-[#8a6417] bg-[linear-gradient(180deg,#2b1d10,#140d07)] px-4 py-2 flex items-center justify-between
global_reskin_recipes..tfl-skin .btn: .fr-btn styled gold pill/rounded button with font-Cinzel font-black uppercase text-[#2a1503] bg-[linear-gradient(180deg,#fff2a6_0%,#f6c445_40%,#c78313_75%,#8a520a_100%)] border-2 border-[#fff0b3] shadow-[0_0_14px_rgba(255,200,60,0.45)] hover:brightness-110 active:scale-95 transition-all
global_reskin_recipes..tfl-skin .btn-gold: Glow-enhanced primary CTA with ember pulse animation
global_reskin_recipes..tfl-skin .btn-dark: Dark mahogany pill with gold border (.fr-btn-dark)
global_reskin_recipes..tfl-skin .input: .fr-input styled dark wood inset input (bg-[rgba(5,3,2,0.75)] border border-[#8a6417] text-[#fdf1cf] focus:border-[#ffd863] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#ffd863])
global_reskin_recipes..tfl-skin .table: Cardless ornate table with th styled font-Cinzel text-[#f2c14e] uppercase text-xs tracking-wider border-b border-[#6b4a18] and hover:bg-[#26180c]/60 on rows
global_reskin_recipes..tfl-skin .tab: Gold bordered tab pill with active state bg-[linear-gradient(180deg,#5a3713,#26160a)] border-[#e5b33e] text-[#fff3b0]

modal_behavior.desktop: Centered floating window max-w-4xl max-h-[85vh] rounded-lg border-3 border-[#f0c04a] shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] backdrop-blur-md fr-modal
modal_behavior.mobile_portrait_390px: Full viewport bottom sheet or 95vw centered fit with sticky header and scrollable body scroll-gold
modal_behavior.square_phone_720x720: Tightened layout [data-layout='square'] with 40px action rings, compact paddings, max height 680px
modal_behavior.corners: 4 gem corners (.fr-corner.tl, .tr, .bl, .br) with cyan/teal glowing jewels

rebuilt_core_menus.shop: Gear cards grid (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4). Each card has rarity frame (.rar-frame), item portrait with drop-shadow, stat badges (Power, Luck, Line Tension), price in Gold/Pearls, and a .fr-btn Buy button.
rebuilt_core_menus.tackle_box: Equipped slots bar (Rod, Reel, Line, Bait, Charm) with glowing active slots + inventory bag grid (4x4 / 6x4 slots) with item rarity borders, item count stacks, and quick equip/inspect tooltip overlay.
rebuilt_core_menus.fishdex: Water species grid grouped by location (12 waters). Discovered fish show colored art + rarity border + length record + stats; undiscovered show silhouette with question mark badge & hint.
rebuilt_core_menus.travel_map: Interactive 12 water cards layout with location artwork, level lock badges, fish species counts, weather/time modifiers, and a golden 'Travel' CTA button.
rebuilt_core_menus.profile: Angler Plaque hero section with custom avatar frame (.av-frame), title selector, stat hex/bars (Total Caught, Trophy Fish, Gold Earned, Masteries), and achievement badges.

motion.hover: translateY(-2px) scale(1.02) with gold shadow glow boost
motion.animations: dotpulse, floaty, rise entrance, pop modal appearance, legend-shine for mythic items
motion.prefers_reduced_motion: Disable continuous floaty and shine keyframes when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Text color #fdf1cf on dark wood backgrounds (ratio > 7:1); bright gold headers #f2c14e
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g. data-testid="shop-buy-button-rod-1", data-testid="tab-tacklebox", data-testid="water-card-lake-1")

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply .fr-panel and .tfl-skin reskin globally across all legacy text MMO pages without breaking state or logic.
Rebuild the 5 core menus (Shop, Tackle Box, Fishdex, Travel Map, Profile) into full game visual components matching League of Angels fantasy MMO aesthetic.
Maintain responsive scaling for desktop, 390px mobile portrait, and 720x720 square viewports.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, tabs, modal controls, and item slots carry proper data-testid attributes.
